capabilities: Convert notes into tracked notes with IDs and revision/question files
Create and review flashcard-style questions from selected text
Run flashcard quizzes filtered by topic tags
Show daily reviews of changed or unreviewed notes with reminders
Mark note revisions as reviewed and view diffs between versions
extras: The README states Learnie is in early development and may have instabilities. Planned enhancements include fixing LaTeX and Markdown rendering and adding a local LLM vector search; issues and suggestions are handled via GitHub.
motivation: The author wants to help students and lifelong learners remember and learn more effectively using active recall and spaced repetition.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn notes into active-recall study material or to schedule and track their review.
summary: Spaced-repetition study plugin that converts notes into tracked notes, generates review questions and flashcard quizzes, and prompts daily review.
